# Experiment 40: L2-sensitivity K-sweep, tables (NOT preregistered; generated by scripts/analyze_l2_sensitivity.py)

**Reading guide.** Every number is the TEST split, normalized ranked probability score (RPS divided by K - 1; 0 to 1; lower is better), averaged over each test item's ratings first and then over items. gap = test normalized RPS of the Pearson-trained (or MSE-trained) head minus test normalized RPS of the cross-entropy-trained (CE-trained) head; positive = the CE-trained head is better. "raw" = the head's own distribution, ridge penalty chosen per head on VALIDATION normalized RPS of the raw forecast; "matched" = the head's scalar mean score passed through a multinomial-logit map fitted by cross-entropy to the validation ratings (separately per head), penalty chosen on VALIDATION normalized RPS of the calibrated forecast. Each cell: seed-mean (min..max over five split seeds); number of seeds whose paired item-clustered 95% bootstrap interval is above 0 / straddles 0 / is below 0. Heads: linear softmax on 24 train-only principal components of a 256-dimensional signed token hash, L-BFGS (at most 300 iterations), penalty grid 1e-5 to 1.

Files merged: k_sweep_l2_sensitivity_shard0of2.json, k_sweep_l2_sensitivity_shard1of2.json; rows 80 (= 16 views x 5 seeds).

## 4. Replication check against the preregistered run (penalty 0.01, 300 iterations)

Cells compared: 80. Largest absolute difference in the seed gap, this run minus the preregistered run: raw Pearson-trained minus CE-trained 0.00e+00; matched 0.00e+00; raw MSE-trained minus CE-trained 9.85e-03; matched 1.47e-03. Pearson-minus-CE gaps at lambda = 0.01 should reproduce the preregistered 300-iteration run (same penalty function); the MSE gaps should NOT, because the ridge form changed (0.5 N lambda on X'X instead of lambda).

## 5. Preregistered rules re-scored at the validation-selected penalties (L2-sensitivity; NOT preregistered)

- **P1_binary_matched_gap**: supported. Rule: on every binary view the absolute seed-mean matched gap is below 0.003. max_abs = 0.0021671402599641723; violations = []
- **P2_raw_gap_positive_signal_raw**: supported. Rule: seed-mean raw gap positive on at least 90% of signal views (primary: signal = seed-mean (constant minus CE-trained head, raw) > 0). n_signal_views = 12; n_positive = 12; share_positive = 1.0; exceptions = []
- **P2_raw_gap_positive_signal_strict**: supported. Rule: seed-mean raw gap positive on at least 90% of signal views (strict: calibrated CE-trained head beats constant with the interval above 0 on >= 3 of 5 seeds). n_signal_views = 8; n_positive = 8; share_positive = 1.0; exceptions = []
- **P3_K3plus_matched_gap**: supported. Rule: for K of 3 or more the absolute seed-mean matched gap is below 0.003 on at least 80% of views; refuted if a K >= 3 view has a gap above 0.005 with the interval above 0 on at least 3 of 5 seeds. n_views = 10; n_within_tolerance = 10; share_within = 1.0; max_matched_gap = 0.00196943154046394; shape_learning_indicated_on = []; views_at_or_above_tolerance_with_interval_above_0_on_3_of_5_seeds = []
- **P5_strata**: not supported. Rule: in both entropy strata the seed-mean raw gap is positive and the absolute seed-mean matched gap is below 0.003. n_views_with_strata = 13; n_views_both_conditions = 10; violations = ['chaosnli_alphanli|K2', 'dices990|K2', 'dices990|K3']
